subject: PO token mismatch & line-item correction for Helix Systems onboarding
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@helixsys.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-20T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding / PO issuance question

Hi Priyom,

We're completing the onboarding form (attached) but ran into a snag: the provisional PO token you sent (HLX-12345) maps to a legacy spend envelope that caps at $50k — our first purchase for the implementation is $72,400 and includes three SKUs with line-level quantities that need to be preserved. Procurement here is asking whether Redwood can reissue against a new PO number or temporarily lift the cap so the order doesn't fragment across multiple POs.

Can you advise who on your side owns temporary PO issuance and whether a single consolidated PO is possible? We prefer a single PO to keep billing and ship-to logic consistent.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Procurement Lead, Helix Systems
Attachments: Helix_Onboarding_Form_20270620.pdf
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@helixsys.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-20T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / PO issuance question

Sanjay — thanks for flagging this and for the completed form. Short answer: we can either (A) reissue a new PO token with a higher spend bracket, or (B) issue a consolidated provisional PO and request a spend-cap exception on your behalf.

To move quickly I need two things from Redwood procurement: Monica, Ben — can you confirm which path is faster operationally? Notes:
- If we reissue a new PO token we'll need the exact total and confirmed line quantities to avoid downstream splits.
- For a spend-cap exception, we can raise it to $100k for this customer as a one-time override pending contract signature, but that requires an internal approval and a short memo (1–2 business days).

Sanjay — which do you prefer? If you send the final SOW/order line items I can start the request this morning.

Best,
Priyom
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-20T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendor onboarding / PO issuance question

Forwarding Helix ask — I started a provisional PO (attached) but noticed the line item breakdown in HLX-12345 only contains aggregated SKUs (SKU-A x1, SKU-B x1) rather than the detailed lines Helix sent (SKU-A x4, SKU-B x2, SKU-C x1). If we issue a new PO token we should preserve the vendor line granularity to ensure accurate invoicing and fulfillment.

Attachment: Provisional_PO_HLX-12345.csv

Action items for procurement:
- Ben: can you confirm if we can reissue HLX-12345 with line-level expansion OR create HLX-12346 as a single consolidated token with a $100k cap?
- Priyom: ask Helix to confirm final line quantities (preferably in the attached csv format).

Thanks,
Monica
Procurement Ops
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, priyom.das@redwood.com
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-21T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vendor onboarding / PO issuance question

Quick ops note — we can do either approach but timeline differs:

Option 1 — Reissue expanded token (HLX-12346): ~4 hours to generate, low-touch (no approval) if total < $75k.
Option 2 — One-time spend-cap exception to $100k for HLX-12345: requires manager approval and a short memo (I can draft). Turnaround ~24–48 hours depending on approvals.

Because Helix total is $72,400, reissuing HLX-12346 with preserved line items is the fastest path and avoids approval overhead. However, our billing system needs the lines exactly as Helix provided to prevent SKU aggregation that caused the initial mismatch. Monica — please confirm the canonical line CSV and I will stamp HLX-12346. Jordan — FYI this will affect downstream entitlement mapping (may need to nudge accounting if billing code needs to change).

-Ben
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@helixsys.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-22T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO token mismatch & line-item correction for Helix Systems onboarding

Thanks team — confirmed final order below (also attached updated csv):
- SKU-A (Implementation seats): 4 x $7,500 = $30,000
- SKU-B (Integration hours): 2 x $8,700 = $17,400
- SKU-C (On-prem appliance): 1 x $25,000 = $25,000
Total: $72,400

We're good with reissuing HLX-12346 with full line detail. Please send the new PO token and the provisional PO PDF so our AP team can match it to our SOW and avoid split shipments.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Sanjay
